in_marathi.name: Bandan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Bound or Protected
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bandan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Bandan is derived from the Sanskrit word 'bandhana' which means 'to bind' or 'to protect'. This name is often given to children to signify that they are bound or protected by the divine.
